children: My Size announced a private placement expected to raise approximately $2.5 million through pre-funded warrants and Series C/D warrants, priced at $1.91 per pre-funded warrant with associated warrants. Pre-funded warrants are exercisable at $0.001; Series C and D warrants are exercisable at $1.66, with five-year and 18-month terms, respectively, from the registration effective date. The company also entered a Registration Rights Agreement to register resales of the warrant shares within prescribed SEC timelines, with liquidated damages for delays. H.C. Wainwright was engaged as exclusive placement agent, earning cash fees and placement agent warrants for 91,623 shares at a $2.3875 exercise price. Closing is expected on or about September 16, 2026, subject to customary conditions.
